defs.def: to put clothes, etc. into a bag in preparation for a trip away from home 收拾（行李）；装（箱）

ex.s: I continued to make these pencil marks for years, and when I went off to college, I packed that dictionary in my suitcase.
ex.t: 多年来我一直做着这些铅笔标记，离家上大学时，我把那本词典装进了行李箱。

ex.s: Packing for a move.
ex.t: 为搬家打包行李。

ex.s: Pack a bag cut a cake, guess which juice container holds the most liquid, and much more.
ex.t: 装好一个袋子、切一块蛋糕、猜哪个果汁容器装得最多液体，还有更多。

ex.s: Then all we have to do is pack luggage.
ex.t: 那我们要做的就是打包行李了。

ex.s: Packing up my parents’ house felt like a massive goodbye — that bedroom, those memories, the feeling of safety and shelter I always felt there.
ex.t: 收拾我父母房子的过程就像一场盛大的告别——那间卧室、那些回忆，还有我在那里始终感受到的安全与庇护。

defs.def: to put sth into a container so that it can be stored, transported or sold 打包；包装

ex.s: On our final morning in the house, we took a break from the mind-bending, never-ending work of packing to sit down for that last breakfast.
ex.t: 我们暂停了那令人头疼、没完没了的打包工作，坐下来吃最后一顿早餐。

ex.s: there would be too much work in packing
ex.t: 打包的工作会太多。

ex.s: Pack the food for her.
ex.t: 为她打包食物。

ex.s: When I hurried to the store, I saw that the books were already being packed into boxes.
ex.t: 当我匆忙赶到书店时，我看到书已经在被打包装箱了。

ex.s: Past continuous passive a When I hurried to the store, I saw that the books were already being packed into boxes.
ex.t: 过去进行时被动语态 当我匆忙赶到书店时，我看到书已经在被打包装箱了。

ex.s: When I was 9, we packed up our home in Los Angeles and arrived at Heathrow, London on a gray January morning.
ex.t: 9岁时，我们打包了在洛杉矶的家，在一个灰蒙蒙的一月早晨抵达伦敦希思罗机场。

ex.s: But the look on everybody’s face when you’re finished and packing, it’s the best smile in the world; and there’s nobody hurt, and the well’s under control.
ex.t: 但完事后在打包时，每个人脸上的表情，那是世界上最灿烂的笑容；而且没有人受伤，火井也控制住了。

ex.s: However, though it’s nice to get a few cents off a pack of sausages, it would help even more if they could sometimes   61   (offer) in smaller packs.
ex.t: 不过，虽说买一包香肠能省下几毛钱是件好事，但如果它们有时能____以更小包装出售，帮助会更大。

ex.s: Over the last two years, some supermarkets   62   (start) selling chicken or salad in packs   63   (design) with two halves containing separate portions (份).
ex.t: 过去两年里，一些超市____开始销售鸡肉或沙拉，采用分成两半、各装一份的____包装。

ex.s: Who knows, perhaps some of the more forward-looking   65   (one) may yet come out with a whole range of “just for you” pack sizes with special offers as well.
ex.t: 谁知道呢，也许一些更有远见的____将来也会推出一整套「专为你」的包装规格，并配以特别优惠。

ex.s: These pieces can be folded into a neat little pack and fastened on your belt.
ex.t: 这些部件可以折成一个整齐的小包，系在你的腰带上。

defs.def: to protect sth that breaks easily by surrounding it with soft material （在四周填入软料以）包装（易损物品）
to preserve food in a particular substance （用某物）保存，保藏
to fill sth with a lot of people or things 塞进；挤进

ex.s: Its calendar is always packed with headline-grabbing events.
ex.t: 它的活动日程总是排满了引人注目的重磅活动。

ex.s: It is packed with complex codes.
ex.t: 它充满复杂的代码。

ex.s: Our fast train was packing with passengers.
ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 我们的快车上挤满了乘客。

ex.s: After all, how many of us today would rather send a message packed with emojis than make a telephone call?
ex.t: 毕竟，今天我们中有多少人宁愿发一条满是表情符号的信息，也不愿打一个电话呢？

defs.def: to press sth such as snow or soil to form a thick hard mass 堆积；压实
to carry a gun 佩带，携带（枪支）
to have sth 夹带着
to be capable of hitting sb very hard 拳击手

ex.s: Sherman Cymru is excited to present a packed programme of the very best theatre, dance, family shows and music from Wales and the rest of the world.
ex.t: Sherman Cymru 很兴奋地推出一系列精彩的戏剧、舞蹈、家庭演出以及来自威尔士和世界各地的音乐节目。

defs.def: to have a powerful effect on sb 产生巨大影响；十分有效力
to do a lot of things in a limited period of time 在（有限时间里）做（大量工作）

ex.s: They tolerate long, slow journeys to and from work on packed highways because they can work, entertain themselves or sleep on the ride, which encourages urban spread.
ex.t: 他们能忍受在拥挤的公路上往返工作途中的漫长缓慢旅程，因为他们可以在路上工作、娱乐或睡觉，这助长了城市的扩张。

defs.def: to put a lot of things or people into a limited space 在（有限空间里）塞进（大量的人或物）；塞满

ex.s: Many parents say there’s too much traffic on the roads for their children to walk safely to school, so they pack them into the car instead.
ex.t: 许多家长说路上车太多，孩子没法安全步行上学，所以他们干脆把孩子塞进车里。

ex.s: Staring at the bookcases in my study, packed with so many great books that had remained unread, I heard a loud voice in my head — “Shame on you!
ex.t: 盯着书房里塞满了许多本一直未读的好书的书架，我脑海里响起一个响亮的声音——「你真丢人！」

ex.s: It is a well-known fact, especially in my school, that Junior year is the time of packing many AP classes into the schedule.
ex.t: 尤其是在我的学校里，众所周知高二（Junior year）是把许多 AP 课程塞进课表的时候。

ex.s: The three dogs formed a pack that, with coaching, ______56______ Flora’s space; Steve and I formed a good team ______57______ for Tilly.
ex.t: 三只狗组成了一个群体，经过训练，它们______56______占据 Flora 的空间；Steve 和我组成了一个好团队______57______照顾 Tilly。

defs.def: to put your possessions into a bag, etc. before leaving a place 打行李；收拾行装

ex.s: Filled with   64   (curious), the artist packed his bags and left.
ex.t: 充满（好奇心），这位艺术家收拾行李离开了。

defs.def: to stop doing sth, especially a job 停止；放弃；辞掉

ex.s: There were times when I found myself wondering if I should pack it all in, but the boy’s words kept ringing in my ears: I knew I needed nothing else to succeed but a bit of ____54____ and hard work.
ex.t: 有几次我想过要不要干脆放弃，但男孩的话一直在我耳边回响：我知道，成功所需要的不过是一点____和勤奋。

defs.def: a container, usually made of paper, that holds a number of the same thing or an amount of sth, ready to be sold （商品的）纸包，纸袋，纸盒
a set of different things that are supplied together for a particular purpose （一起供应的）全套东西

ex.s: □Annual Subscription with Gift Pack
ex.t: □带礼品包的年度订阅

defs.def: a number of things that are wrapped or tied together, especially for carrying 一捆，一包（尤指适于携带的东西）
a large bag that you carry on your back 大背包

ex.s: How much should you pay if you make a 12-mouth subscription to TOKNOW with gift pack from China?
ex.t: 如果你订购带礼品包的 TOKNOW 12 个月订阅，应该付多少钱？

ex.s: I was ___17___ with a pack nearly as tall as his whole body.
ex.t: 我____背着一个几乎和他整个身体一样高的背包。

defs.def: a group of animals that hunt together or are kept for hunting 一群（动物或猎狗）

ex.s: The US Fish and Wildlife Service carefully monitors and manages the wolf packs in Yellowstone.
ex.t: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局仔细监测和管理黄石公园的狼群。

defs.def: a group of similar people or things, especially one that you do not like or approve of 群；帮；团伙
all the people who are behind the leaders in a race, competition, etc. （统称）竞赛中的落后者
a complete set of 52 playing cards 一副（为 52 张）
an organized group of Cubs/Cub Scouts or Brownies 一队（男或女幼童军）
a hot or cold piece of soft material that absorbs liquid, used for treating a wound （治创伤用的）裹布，填塞物，敷料
